# The `.code-forge.yml` that `code-forge init --no-interaction` writes for this fixture
# (block B13a), run under Claude Code (CLAUDECODE=1) with the Jev key in CODE_FORGE_KEY_JEV.
# No Solo in that run: `engine: auto` resolves to the harness, so `caps.coders` is 1 (§5.5, B19).
# B24: proof settings are not asked. High-risk paths are a deliberate blank; `link_dirs` follows
# the manifests (`composer.json` ⇒ vendor, `package.json` ⇒ node_modules, installed or not);
# `copy_untracked` keeps only files that exist, and `.env`/`.env.testing` do not.
# B65: `autonomy` is always written, both keys; with no flag both answers are no.
version: 1
project:
  name: laravel-vue
  slug: laravel-vue
provider: anthropic
levels:
  L0:
    model: claude-haiku-4-5-20251001
  L1:
    model: claude-sonnet-5
  L2:
    model: claude-opus-5-5
  L3:
    model: claude-fable-5-1
caps:
  coders: 1
review:
  multimodel: false
engine: auto
harnesses:
  - claude
keys:
  jev: env:CODE_FORGE_KEY_JEV
gates:
  test:
    - php
    - artisan
    - test
    - --compact
  lint: null
  types:
    - vendor/bin/phpstan
  format:
    - vendor/bin/pint
    - --test
proof:
  tiers:
    high:
      paths: []
  isolation: export
  export:
    link_dirs:
      - vendor
      - node_modules
    copy_untracked: []
autonomy:
  coder_may_push: false
  coder_may_open_draft_pr: false

    build: [npm, run, typecheck]
    test: [node, --import, ./test/helpers/isolate.mjs, --experimental-test-module-mocks, --test]
